title: Claude Code Plugin Manifest
description: Schema for .claude-plugin/plugin.json — permissive to the fields Claude Code documents, strict about unknown keys so a typo fails validation.

version.description: Strict semantic version, kept in parity with the Cursor manifest.

description.description: Short description of what the plugin does.

repository.description: URL to the plugin's source repository.

skills.description: Path(s) to skill directories or files; defaults to ./skills/.

agents.description: Path(s) to agent definition files; defaults to the agents/ directory.

commands.description: Path(s) to command files; defaults to the commands/ directory.

hooks.description: Path to a hooks configuration file, or an inline hooks object.

mcpServers.description: Path to an MCP server configuration file, or an inline configuration object.

lspServers.description: Path to an LSP server configuration file, or an inline configuration object.

userConfig.description: JSON Schema describing user-configurable plugin settings.

dependencies.description: Other plugins this plugin depends on, keyed by plugin name.

defaultEnabled.description: Whether the plugin is enabled by default after installation.

settings.description: Optional Claude Code settings component declaration; validated by the Claude Code CLI.

themes.description: Optional Claude Code themes component declaration; validated by the Claude Code CLI.

workflows.description: Optional Claude Code workflows component declaration; validated by the Claude Code CLI.

channels.description: Optional Claude Code channels component declaration; validated by the Claude Code CLI.

monitors.description: Optional Claude Code monitors component declaration; validated by the Claude Code CLI.

semver.description: Strict semantic version "X.Y.Z" with optional prerelease and build metadata.
